goal: Prevent nodes from leaking IP addresses and wallet ownership when receiving incoming payments
Stop periodic rebroadcasting and startup mempool resubmission of transactions not spending wallet inputs
reviewability: Author defended trade-offs and proposed adjustments to handle CPFP parent resubmission
agreement: Concept approval without stated reasons, suggests making behavior configurable (vasild)
Answered objection: incoming rebroadcasts aid confirmation and are required for CPFP (achow101)
Answered objection: wallet CPFP children stay out of mempool if unconfirmed parents are skipped (fametrano)

categories.name: wallet
why: P1 because it fixes a long-standing privacy leak that allows attackers to deanonymize passive wallet nodes
Attackers can send low-fee transactions and observe which node rebroadcasts them to link wallets to IPs
